plan.title: Purchase Items blocked for pending PR

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the buyer.
Use the Open tab where the case expects the PR list to start.
Select the available PR line so the Purchase Items control can be inspected.
Assert that Purchase Items remains disabled for the non-purchasable PR.
